projection.name: pulsar
projection.title: Apache Pulsar
projection.description: Pulsar browser for tenants, namespaces, topics, subscriptions, producers, consumers, schemas, message browsing, live tailing, and publishing.

fields.label: Admin API URL
fields.help: Broker or proxy web service URL that serves the /admin/v2 REST API.

fields.label: Broker service URL
fields.help: Binary protocol URL used to produce and tail messages. Browsing works without it.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional mutual-TLS certificate presented to the broker.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks produce, create, cursor changes, and delete operations.

fields.label: Show system topics
fields.help: Include the broker's internal topics (transaction, change events, health check) in topic listings.

fields.label: Message page size
fields.help: Upper bound on how many messages one browse request reads from a topic.

config.emptyText: This tenant has no namespaces yet.
This namespace has no topics yet.
No producer is connected to this topic.
No consumer is connected to this topic.
No messages are retained on this topic.
No consumer is attached to this subscription.
This subscription has no readable backlog.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this tenant? It must have no namespaces left.

fields.label: Bundles
fields.help: Number of hash bundles the namespace is split into. Leave empty for the broker default.

fields.label: Retention time (minutes)
fields.help: 0 disables time retention; -1 keeps messages forever.

actions.label: Unload
actions.confirmText: Unload this namespace? Every producer and consumer on it is disconnected while the bundles move.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this namespace and every topic in it?

actions.label: Unload
actions.confirmText: Unload this topic? Connected producers and consumers reconnect through another broker.

actions.label: Terminate
actions.confirmText: Terminate this topic? No message can ever be published to it again.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this topic and every message stored in it?

actions.label: Delete schema
actions.confirmText: Delete every registered schema version for this topic?

actions.label: Produce
actions.confirmText: Publish this message to the topic?

fields.label: Key
fields.help: Routing key used by partitioned topics and key-shared subscriptions.

actions.label: Skip messages
actions.confirmText: Skip messages on this subscription? They are acknowledged without being delivered.

fields.label: Messages to skip
fields.help: Acknowledges the next N messages without delivering them.

actions.label: Clear backlog
actions.confirmText: Clear the whole backlog? Every pending message is acknowledged and never delivered.

actions.label: Reset cursor
actions.confirmText: Reset this cursor? Connected consumers are disconnected and the delivery position moves.

fields.label: How far back
fields.help: Used when resetting to a point in time; the cursor moves to now minus this duration.

actions.label: Expire messages
actions.confirmText: Expire the older part of this backlog? Those messages are acknowledged and never delivered.

fields.label: Older than
fields.help: Acknowledges every backlog message published before now minus this duration.

actions.label: Delete
actions.confirmText: Delete this subscription and its cursor?
